title: viz tick
description: Payload of `stride viz tick` — one poll-and-mark cycle of the window's directive lifecycle, run without a window so the lifecycle can be tested headless. found says whether a fresh pending directive won this cycle; acked says whether this cycle wrote its terminal status.

status.description: The status this cycle left the winner in: applied; pending when not acked; raced when the mark matched no row because another executor closed the winner between this cycle's select and its mark (acked is false, nothing was written); none when nothing won. The tick honours every field, so it never writes applied_partial — that verdict needs the window's model.
